Host power and thermal state were not experimentally fixed. Quiet checks monitor known competing workloads, not all system GPU activity.

findings.status: observational, with a repeatable Classic-highlight GPU cost and explicit unavailable comparisons
findings.interpretation: Classic Highlights GPU pass-work increased across all three before/after diagnostic observations. The HDR blend operation itself did not show a corresponding increase. Instrumented GPU work is distinct from Off application latency. A redundant exact donor-bucket calculation in the serial correction-table loop is a reviewed optimization candidate, not an implemented or measured fix.
findings.memory: Medians of per-run sampled physical-footprint peaks did not increase. Logical GPU inventories were unchanged at the reported checkpoints. Other logical totals were essentially stable, with about 2 MiB of initial reservation variation in eight-photo editing. These are not settled whole-process or measured VRAM observations.
findings.variance: The initial Browse warm-edit median difference did not repeat in reversed order. HDR warm-edit median difference largely diminished in reversed order. Individual percentages are not automatic regression verdicts.
